name: outpipe
description: Standalone tunneling platform with Go relays, a TypeScript dashboard, and a Tauri desktop client

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,tunnel,web -c blue,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:tunnel" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api && npm run build:tunnel && npm run build:cron && npm run build:check && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:web: npm run generate-routes && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace packages/react && npm run build --workspace packages/vite-plugin && npm run build --workspace packages/next && npm run build --workspace packages/nest && npm run build --workspace packages/express && npm run build --workspace packages/angular
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run build:types --workspace packages/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/react && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/vite-plugin && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/next && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/nest && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/express && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/angular
